title: SV Werder Bremen
content: # SV Werder Bremen. Association football club in Germany. For the Werder Bremen women's team, see SV Werder Bremen (women) "SV Werder Bremen (women)"). V.** (German pronunciation:  ⓘ), commonly known as **Werder Bremen**, **Werder** or simply **Bremen**, is a German professional sports club based in Bremen. Founded on 4 February 1899, Werder are best known for their professional association football team, who compete in the Bundesliga, the first tier of the German football league system. Bremen share the record for most seasons played in the Bundesliga with Bayern Munich, and are ranked third in the all-time Bundesliga table, only behind Bayern and Borussia Dortmund. The team's first major trophy was the 1960–61 DFB-Pokal; they last won the cup in 2008–09. In European football, Werder won the 1991–92 European Cup Winners' Cup, and were runners-up in the 2008–09 UEFA Cup. Bremen have played at the Weserstadion since 1909.
